description: Dry-run a transaction against live chain state without sending it. Returns success, error, program logs and compute units used. Use it to test a transaction; for a SAFE or UNSAFE verdict with fix hints use validate_transaction. Nothing is broadcast. Example: {"transaction":"<base64 transaction>"} Cost: 3 free calls, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402. Calls that return an error are not charged.

network.description: Cluster to query: "mainnet-beta" (real funds; the default) or "devnet" (test network). Optional.

transaction.description: The transaction to test: base64-encoded serialized VersionedTransaction (not a legacy Transaction), signed or unsigned (required).

name: simulate_solana_transaction
